The person in the picture is smiling and saluting, The five-starred red flag fluttered in the wind behind, while white doves spread their wings and soared.

Keep the second image unchanged. Place the character from the first image into the second image, maintaining the character's features and clothing unchanged. The character sits inside the picture frame, holding flowers in his left hand while raising his right hand above his head in salute.

All the people in the frame smoothly morph into stylized 3D cartoon characters. Simultaneously, the background transforms into a vibrant blue sky with fluffy white clouds.
The character jumps and slowly drifts backward, sits inside the picture frame, conjures a bouquet of flowers with his left hand, and salutes with his right.
